result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, promotional tone built on a family metaphor (Ohana) and four named core values. Customers are addressed first, and the page speaks in first-person plural throughout. Commitments are stated absolutely ('We’re obsessed with', 'We respect and value') with few hedges. Awards, testimonials and recruiting appeals carry much of the page, and Shareholders and Safety are essentially absent.
